title: Renode 1.17 cortex-m55 native MVE/LOB golden; typographic C/asm translation of nrf_model 0x43A698/0x43A1B0 matches EVENBAT, 24 random inputs, and param_9 mutant; source-only estimate replaced
scope: Host/emulator only. No hardware flash. No commit. Official opencfw-otap-disarm.app.bin was not overwritten. The earlier Unicorn NOP+hook harness is not the official golden.
correction: NOP-patching 155 MVE sites would corrupt a golden because those ops compute values. qemu-system-arm -M mps3-an547 has cortex-m55/MVE but its map does not include the stock 0x00438000 window, and this Homebrew macOS install has no qemu-arm user-mode. The accepted reference is Renode 1.17 (vendor/renode-src commit e8c7c2d) with CPU.CortexM cpuType cortex-m55, FPU enabled, MRAM at 0x00400000, DTCM at 0x20000000.
note_result_base: RESULT was moved off SP 0x2007FB00 (the first golden at 0x2007F200 was stack-smashed on later random cases). Clean dumps are golden2-results.bin and mutant2-results.bin.

stock_identity.iar_expf: 0x0043BA98 (in-tree iar_expf.c / shim; left at stock VA in the standalone test)

translation.method: Typographic relocation of stock Thumb/MVE bodies in GNU as (.byte streams plus size-preserving bl / .word symbol patches). Not a portable scalar C lift of the algorithm. Internal PC-relative pools and short branches stay valid because each function layout is preserved. Cross-function bl rewritten to symbols. MVE and LOB opcodes remain as raw bytes and are executed by the M55.
translation.wrappers: g2/src/apollo-main/drivers/power/npm1300/battery-model/g2c_fuel_gauge_source.c (init/ext/process/tte/ttf C wrappers, version c205a2 / Apr 28 2025, opt buffers 0x70 bytes, no expf/logf definitions)
translation.cores: g2/src/apollo-main/drivers/power/npm1300/battery-model/g2c_fuel_gauge_cores.S (production names fg_memcpy/fg_memset; tte_cached label demoted so it does not clash with g2c_fuel_gauge_model_tte.c)
translation.build: Cores assembled with profile g2-apollo-main-mve-1 (-mcpu=cortex-m55, MVE allowed). Apple clang rejected .arch_extension fp/mve, so those directives were stripped; MVE instructions are .byte data and do not need the assembler mnemonic extension. Wrappers stay on g2-apollo-main-1 (cortex-m55+nomve, -std=c11, hard-float).
translation.standalone_test: build/fuel-gauge-recon-20261122/c-recon/ linked at 0x00401000, EVENBAT and IAR math mapped at stock VAs, BSS at 0x20060000, RESULT at 0x20068000

compare.method: Tag-aligned record compare against clean golden2/mutant2. The stock harness overwrote the 0x1001 tag with the count word at RESULT+4; the C harness reserved that slot, shifting subsequent tags by one word. Raw 2048-byte dumps are therefore not SHA-identical. From the first payload word through end-tag 0xE0D00000 the records are bit-exact.
compare.evenbat_and_random: PASS, bit-exact (init, 4.10, 4.20 samples including TTE 27427.212890625, all 24 xorshift cases)
compare.param_9_mutant: PASS, bit-exact (r0 doubled to 4.7176408767700195, first rest SOC unchanged)
compare.verdict: PASS. The typographic C/asm translation matches the Renode M55 native-MVE/LOB golden on EVENBAT, random inputs, and the param_9 mutant. The source-only estimate was replaced in-tree.

in_tree_replacement.sources_json: Added profile g2-apollo-main-mve-1 and a new unit for g2c_fuel_gauge_cores.S (payload g2-apollo-main, toolchain clang, role candidate). units=4880.
